risk_note: RV2 migration (db/migrations/0100_payout-recon.sql, db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts generated): the two R2 channel-reconciliation tables of BR-WDR-23 (D10-408; 04 rows at SPEC_REF 37808a50 after #1749). app.recon_channel holds the detail rows: result ∈ matched / paying_query / paying_manual / diff, our_status null or one of the seven withdrawal statuses, non-negative amounts in bigint fen. It has named partial unique indexes (app_id, bill_date, out_biz_no) WHERE out_biz_no IS NOT NULL and (app_id, bill_date, channel_order_id) WHERE channel_order_id IS NOT NULL. app.payout_recon_runs is the daily run record: status ∈ succeeded / partial / failed, channel alipay only, non-negative counts, finished_at ≥ started_at, unique (app_id, channel, bill_date); it is the source of the consecutive-success days (B2-07d). Grants are in the migration: couli_app gets SELECT / INSERT plus a column-level UPDATE only on the rerun columns, including out_biz_no and channel_order_id so a same-day rerun can fill the key the first run lacked; there is no DELETE / TRUNCATE. couli_payout and couli_readonly read only; couli_maint has no access. All constraints and indexes are named, and lint-migrations passes. Both tables are guarded as funds tables by CT-06zxj (#1752: recon_channel in FUNDS_TABLE_NAMES, payout_recon_runs through the payout prefix, both in the gate test's expected set). The schema snapshot was regenerated on the test machine (remote-snapshot), and db:check passed after the rebase. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36), red PASS on the rebased spec commit (24 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 subagents in two runs (r2: the rerun column grants). Full verify on the test machine: full-1 (before the rebase) exit 1 only on tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts, fixed on main by CT-06zxj; full-2 (after the rebase) lost its ssh connection mid-run (Connection closed by the remote host, exit 2, no result). Landed with SKIP_VERIFY as the B2-06g precedent (orchestrator 20:0x); CI verify-int is the check (D10-319).
